args: Obsmetrologia Lean proofing server. Use Lean LSP tools before shell/read/grep for Lean questions: diagnostics for file errors, term goal for proof state, hover/outline/local search for declarations, run_code with #print axioms for axiom audits, and multi_attempt for tactic trials. The Lean package root is lib/emsenn/src/lib/obsmetrologia; LSP file paths are package-root-relative source paths such as Obsmetrologia/Primitive.lean. Whole-project checks use make build or make check from the package root.
